reviewed_by: Claude Code, making Butler mode's Projects picker and board searchable
reason: Operator asked for Butler mode's Projects picker (~1,000 projects in a native select) and the board's Group: Project view to be searchable. The rail select becomes ButlerProjectPicker, a combobox following the chat model picker pattern (type to filter, Active before Quiet with counts, arrows/Enter/Esc, first 80 rows). The board search moves from the top bar to beside Group and filters loaded cards instantly by title, project and model before Core's debounced search. Selected: the Butler thread/search helper tests, the new picker component tests, the popup test for the shared page module, and the four butler-mode real-Core Playwright projects, whose journey now searches the board and picks a project by typing.
exclusions: Only Butler mode's page, its new picker and the settings-assistant doc changed; Core, the API client and other pages are untouched. The Group menu keeps its two options, so no other suite covers this.
